fact: A workshop launched on 18 September 2026 on extending the Registre national des personnes physiques, with a platform for verifying and validating identity to have its first phase done before end-2026, per the minister.

PN-RAVEC workshop of 12-17 January 2026 reviewed draft implementing texts on the mechanisms for constituting an interoperable Registre National des Personnes Physiques under Laws L/2023/019/CNT and L/2023/020/CNT.
The MATD minister says ONECI is pursuing the setting up of the Registre national des personnes physiques, with a biometric census at national scale in 2025.
